result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Client has consent-free affiliate and successor assignment rights; TrueLink requires consent that may not be unreasonably withheld and may never assign to a Client competitor; and Client change of control creates no termination right. It preserves the clause’s unrelated commercial intent and is professionally drafted. However, it goes modestly beyond the stated position by adding reorganization and barring suspension or repricing, not merely termination, following a change of control.
